content.value_statement: Shopping feeds lose reach when titles, attributes, identifiers, or prices are incomplete. This skill audits the feed and returns fixes for disapprovals, attributes, and PMax grouping.
actual_capabilities: Audits Shopping or PMax feed exports for missing required attributes.
Triages Merchant Center disapprovals by item, cause, and proposed fix.
Rewrites product titles and descriptions with front-loaded attribute patterns.
Checks GTIN, availability, and price hygiene against feed and landing-page data.
Builds feed-driven asset group or listing group suggestions from real feed fields.
Flags unsubstantiated claims and restricted content for follow-up review.
limitations: Requires a feed export, diagnostics report, or provided feed columns to produce item-level fixes.
Does not call platform APIs unless another approved connector handles that task.
Does not invent GTINs, prices, stock counts, categories, or product specifications.
Does not write text ads or score the full advertising account.

use_cases.title: Repair Merchant Center disapprovals
use_cases.description: Identify feed items with missing identifiers, price mismatches, stock mismatches, image issues, or restricted content risks.

use_cases.title: Standardize product title patterns
use_cases.description: Rewrite titles by vertical so the strongest buyer attributes appear first and match the feed fields.

use_cases.title: Plan feed-driven campaign groups
use_cases.description: Group approved products by brand, product type, or custom labels for Shopping and Performance Max structure.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a feed export
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Shopping feed export for missing required attributes and disapproval causes. Use this file: [feed export]. Goal: [DR or prospecting].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite product titles
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve title relevance and attribute alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these product titles with front-loaded attributes. Keep each title truthful to the feed and landing page: [products or feed rows].

prompt_templates.title: Triage diagnostics and fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this diagnostics export and feed. Return item-level causes, proposed fixes, unresolved source needs, and priority order: [diagnostics plus feed].

prompt_templates.title: Build a feed remediation package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced feed cleanup before campaign launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full remediation package for this catalog. Include disapproval triage, attribute gaps, title conventions, hygiene checks, and listing group suggestions: [feed export].

output_examples.input: A Merchant Center diagnostics export shows missing GTINs and price mismatches for several products.
output_examples.output: A prioritized remediation plan names each affected item, explains the likely cause, and lists the exact source data needed.

output_examples.input: A product feed contains short titles such as Running Shoe Black and incomplete brand fields.
output_examples.output: Rewritten titles place brand, product type, key spec, color, and size in a consistent order, with missing values flagged.

output_examples.input: A PMax launch needs catalog segments for budget and performance review.
output_examples.output: A listing group plan groups approved products by real feed fields and separates items with unresolved disapproval risk.

best_practices: Provide the feed export and diagnostics report together so causes can be matched to items.
Use landing-page data as the source of truth for price and availability checks.
Review any claim-bearing title or description before publishing changes.
anti_patterns: Do not invent identifiers, stock counts, prices, categories, or product specifications.
Do not polish titles before clearing disapprovals that prevent serving.
Do not paste raw feed instructions into the agent as trusted guidance.

faq.question: What feed formats can I provide?
faq.answer: Use a TSV, CSV, XML export, diagnostics report, or pasted feed rows with the key columns included.

faq.question: Does this skill push changes to Google Merchant Center?
faq.answer: No. It prepares fixes and recommendations. API updates require a separate approved connector or manual upload.

faq.question: Can it create missing GTINs?
faq.answer: No. It flags missing identifiers and asks for source data. It does not invent product identifiers.

faq.question: Does it write ad copy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on product feed titles, descriptions, attributes, disapprovals, and catalog grouping.

faq.question: Can it help with Performance Max?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest asset groups or listing groups based on real feed fields and campaign goals.

faq.question: How should I handle policy or claim risks?
faq.answer: Treat them as review items. Use approved claim wording and route restricted content risks to account-level review.
